messages:
maria: beginning region-by-region rollout (US -> EU -> APAC). staged slices: 20% -> 50% -> 100%. ops-lead to monitor capacity and holdpoints.

deploy-bot: deploy started: v2.15.0 (sha: f9b1c3). us=20%, eu=0%, apac=0%. warm pools ok (us-west 10/10). run: deploybot://runs/1768888888

sam: pre-create EU fallback pin v2.14.9 ready (sha: b3c4d5). one-command rollback available.

lee: canary checks in place: p50/p95/p99, 5xx, OOMs. triggers: p99>230ms OR 5xx>0.5% => hold.

deploy-bot: us ramped to 50%. snapshot: p50=58ms p95=115ms p99=205ms 5xx=0.08%.

maria: EU is a hard holdpoint. require 10m stable p99<230ms before ramp beyond 20%.

deploy-bot: eu ramp to 20%. metrics: p99=247ms 5xx=0.25%. alert eu-p99-high posted to #eng-oncall.

sam: investigating eu-gpu-02; seeing GC bursts. restarting agent.

lee: after restart p99 down to ~210ms. recommend hold at 20% for +15m to avoid churn.

ops-lead: auto-rollback rule: if eu p99>265ms for 5m OR 5xx>0.5% for 3m -> rollback to pinned v2.14.9 and page oncall. thresholds set.

maria: APAC warmup planned 02:10 UTC local; will kick 15m early. keep tagging @ops-lead for any roll commands. :thumbsup:
